description: Everything for the Sunday review of one athlete in one call: last 7 days sessions vs plan (with RPE/notes), current load and ramp, attention flags, race outlooks, next week's season envelope and what is already planned. athlete_feedback collects the athlete's own words across the last three weeks and marks those mentioning pain, illness, unusual fatigue or an RPE of 9+. Sessions created with status "proposed" stay invisible to the athlete until they are accepted or discarded. Draws a page in the chat — "The weekly review" — so the figures are on screen: refer to what the page shows rather than retyping it, and spend your words on what it means.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

name: get_weekly_review
